title: sindhinorm: a corpus-guided, native-validated spelling normalizer for Sindhi
description:
sindhinorm normalizes Sindhi text typed on mixed Urdu, Persian and Arabic keyboards. Version 0.2.0 changes only the letters a non-Sindhi keyboard produces and leaves correctly typed Sindhi alone. It decides per word, using word frequencies from Sindhi Wikipedia, and never merges spelling pairs that a native Sindhi speaker judged to be different words. On the UD Sindhi test set it restores 94.9% of words altered by Urdu-keyboard typing and changes 0.03% of clean words.

In a preregistered test, a part-of-speech tagger trained on Sindhi news (SiPOS) scored 0.494 on the same text typed on an Urdu keyboard; with sindhinorm 0.2.0 it scored 0.924, with no measurable change on clean text.

Install: pip install sindhinorm. Code: MIT. Bundled word list: CC BY-SA 4.0 (derived from Sindhi Wikipedia). Part of MorphoTok-SD-UR, a preregistered study of morphology-aware tokenization for Sindhi and Urdu.
